extracted.name: English Muffin Hors d’Oeuvres
extracted.description: English muffins are topped with Cheddar cheese to make a simple appetizer that everyone will enjoy.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven broiler. Set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source.

Mix together Cheddar cheese, mayonnaise, green onions, salt, garlic salt, and pepper in a bowl. Spread cheese mixture over each English muffin half. Cut muffins into quarters and place them on a baking sheet.
Broil in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbly, 4 to 6 minutes.
